stories.headline: Bottomline Partners With Chainlink to Connect 600 Banks to Blockchain Settlement
stories.body: Bottomline, a top-three provider of Swift services, has partnered with Chainlink to give more than 600 bank customers access to blockchain-based cross-border settlement. The deal is one of the largest efforts yet to link the Swift messaging network, which banks have relied on for decades, with public and private blockchains, according to a report from

stories.headline: RIA referrals, tech and service: How TradePMR by Robinhood pitches advisors
stories.body: One year after $300M deal, referrals through Robinhood that put younger investors in the pipeline and an ongoing clearing relationship with Wells Fargo reflect how TradePMR is a growing rival to the giants of the custody channel.

stories.headline: China hits back at G20 statement on its reliance on exports, accusing them of 'promoting protectionism'
stories.body: China rejected G20 pressure over export-driven growth while also challenging U.S. Iran sanctions and European trade measures.
